title: The Tiny Giant
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A very small creature proves that heart size matters more than body size.
long_description: Pip is so small he can hide behind a blade of grass, but he believes he's a giant. The other forest creatures laugh at him, but Pip doesn't mind. When a great wind blows through the forest and causes trouble—knocking down a bird's nest, destroying a mouse's home, and covering a fox's play area—Pip steps up to help. Using his small size to his advantage, he digs a new home for the mice, repairs the bird's nest, and organizes the other small creatures to clear the fox's play area. In the end, the forest creatures realize that Pip may be small in size, but he has the heart of a giant. A heartwarming story about self-perception, kindness, and inner strength.
